intel.title: [CISA KEV] N-able N-central - N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-18556
廠商: N-able
產品: N-central
漏洞名稱: N-able N-central Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
說明: N-able N-central contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel that allows for authentication bypass.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-08-07
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: N-able N-central 存在身份驗證繞過漏洞（CVE-2026-18556），攻擊者可透過替代路徑或通道繞過安全驗證。此漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知利用漏洞清單（KEV），顯示已有在野活躍攻擊。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Apache Tomcat - Apache Tomcat Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data Vulnerability

廠商: Apache
產品: Tomcat
漏洞名稱: Apache Tomcat Missing Encryption of Sensitive Data Vulnerability
說明: Apache Tomcat contains a missing encryption of sensitive data vulnerability that allows the bypass of the EncryptInterceptor.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-08-07
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Apache Tomcat 存在敏感資料未加密漏洞（CVE-2026-34486），該漏洞允許攻擊者繞過 EncryptInterceptor 傳輸未加密的敏感資料。此漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知利用漏洞清單（KEV），具有潛在的利用風險。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] IBM Langflow - IBM Langflow Code Injection Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-9198
廠商: IBM
產品: Langflow
漏洞名稱: IBM Langflow Code Injection Vulnerability
說明: Langflow contains a code injection vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to achieve full remote code execution on default Langflow deployments.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-08-07
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: IBM Langflow 存在代碼注入漏洞（CVE-2026-9198），允許未經身份驗證的攻擊者在預設部署環境中執行遠端代碼（RCE）。該漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知遭利用漏洞清單，具有高度的安全威脅。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
